content.body:
This spring-fired spigot tube weapon fired a rocket that was capable of destroying much German armor due to its HEAT ammunition. A spring launched the bomb out the tube and fused the rocket. The recoil from the rocket reset the spring again so it could be fired again easily. Manually preparing the spring was a cumbersome task.
These bombs were generally effective against armor out to 110 m, but were used against stationary targets as far as 320 m when fired indirectly.
This unique weapon was used by British and Commonwealth forces from the Invasion of Sicily onward and was very effective until the widespread use of skirting by enemy armor.
content.brief: WEAPON: Projector, Infantry, Anti Tank AMMO: Mk 1A HEAT Bomb 1.1 kg (4) MUZZLE VELOCITY: 76 m/s RATE OF FIRE: Single-round spring-fired rocket. OTHER EQUIPMENT: Webley .455 cal (11.6 mm) Revolver Combat Knife
